context.transcript:
Next week marks the beginning of our holiday clearance sale here at Sarmis Department Store.
Now, since this is such an important event, I'll be asking each of you to work an extra shift or two over the course of the week.
We really need a total team effort in order to make this sale a success.
This is the coupon that'll be printed in local newspapers.
You'll notice that we're offering the largest discount on the merchandise that, truthfully, has not been selling very well this season.
We'll be actively promoting it to reduce our inventory and make room for the new merchandise that we'll be receiving in April.
context.transcript_translation:
下周是我们萨尔米斯百货店（Sarmis Department Store）假日清仓大甩卖的开始。
现在，因为这是一个非常重要的活动，我要求大家在这一周内多工作一到两次班次。
为了让这次销售取得成功，我们真的需要一个团队共同努力。
这是将在当地报纸上印刷的优惠券。
你会注意到，我们正在对那些说实话本季卖得不太好的商品提供最大的折扣。
我们将积极推广这些商品以减少我们的库存，并为我们在四月收到的新商品腾出空间。
